title: Presence.from_cbor skips mutation-safe CBOR checks
description:
Presence.from_cbor and PresenceCache.from_cbor call cbor2.loads with no scan. CoAP PUT uses _decode_single_cbor, which rejects tags, duplicate keys, trailing items, and oversized payloads.

cbor2.loads last-wins on duplicate keys, accepts RFC 8746 share/cycle tags, and ignores trailing bytes. The domain codec is the documented wire decoder (module docstring; rust/lichen-client/src/presence.rs from_cbor is the peer). A payload rejected by PUT /presence can still decode as Presence.

File: python/src/lichen/presence.py from_cbor (Presence approx 175-182, PresenceCache approx 241-248)
Compare: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/cbor_validation.py _decode_single_cbor
acceptance_criteria: from_cbor rejects duplicate map keys, CBOR tags, trailing items, and payloads over the mutation byte limit, matching PUT /presence. Vector hex in test/vectors/presence_cbor.json still decodes.
